summary: Frontend-only retest of universal search unified cards, the printer add-to-cart fix, the category pages still using shared cards, and the homepage Featured Suppliers 16:9 banner. All four review items pass cleanly on https://printer-supply-hub.preview.emergentagent.com.
critical_code_review_comments: PrinterProductCard correctly uses addItem from useCart() (the iteration's reported fix). The shared card components keep the data-testid contract identical to the category-page testids, so the universal search now exposes the same Add/Buy/qty controls as /printers/results, /papers, /consumables — confirmed at runtime.

Landing.jsx Featured Suppliers banner uses .tc-featured-banner with aspect-ratio: 16 / 9 set in index.css (line 893-902). Measured at runtime: width=338px, height=190.125px, computed aspectRatio='16 / 9', numeric ratio=1.7777 — exact match.

Featured Suppliers cache (_FEATURED_CACHE 120s TTL on backend) keeps the section snappy; landing page reached DOM + 3s wait in ~3.5s end-to-end with the featured-card already rendered. No long blank state observed.
test_credentials: Not required — all flows tested anonymously.
seed_data_creation: None. Only used existing DB data (xerox -> 2 toners + 2 printers + 4 consumables; cart adds are client-side and not persisted on guest).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Detailed verification results: (1) /search?q=xerox — toners: 2x product-card-<id> with add-to-cart-<id>, buy-now-<id>, qty-<id> steppers (qty-value-<id> rendered, 4 qty-* matches because the testid prefix also matches qty-value-*). Printers: 2x printer-card-<id> with printer-add-to-cart-<id> + printer-buy-now-<id>. Consumables: 4x consumable-card-<id> with consumable-addcart-<id> + consumable-buy-<id>. (2) Clicking printer-add-to-cart-<id> on the universal-search result fired sonner toast 'Added Xerox B235 Multifunction to cart' — confirms PrinterProductCard now correctly calls addItem (the bug fix). (3) Category pages: /papers shows 1 paper-card-<id> with paper-addcart-<id> + paper-buy-<id>; /consumables shows 6 consumable-card-<id> with matching add/buy; /printers/results shows 2 printer-card-<id> with working printer-add-to-cart-<id> (toast 'Added Xerox B305 to cart' + navbar cart badge incremented to 1). (4) Landing: 1 featured-card-<id> + 1 featured-logo-<id> visible; banner computed-style aspect-ratio is exactly 16/9 (338 x 190.125). Section loaded in ~3.5s. No console errors. No overlays or click-interception observed.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — verification-only iteration. The previously reported bug (PrinterCard called a non-existent 'add' function) is fixed: PrinterProductCard.jsx line 23 destructures { addItem } from useCart() and lines 28+33 call addItem(p, 1) inside onAdd/onBuyNow. Toast appears and the cart-count badge in the navbar increments — end-to-end integration is correct.
